title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: A science fiction story about a desert planet, political conflict, powerful families, war, survival, and a valuable resource called spice.

title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
description: A science fiction story about a vast galactic empire, political conflict, science, mathematics, social change, and the struggle to preserve civilization.

author: George Orwell
description: A dystopian story about government control, surveillance, political power, propaganda, censorship, and an individual struggling against an oppressive society.

title: Brave New World
author: Aldous Huxley
description: A dystopian science fiction story about a controlled society, technology, government power, social conditioning, happiness, and individual freedom.

title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: A fantasy adventure about a hobbit who travels through dangerous lands, encounters dragons, dwarves, treasure, magic, and unexpected enemies.

title: The Lord of the Rings
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: An epic fantasy adventure about friendship, war, courage, magic, powerful enemies, a dangerous journey, and the struggle against a dark lord.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
description: A gothic story about a scientist who creates a living creature, exploring ambition, isolation, fear, science, responsibility, and the consequences of creation.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
description: A gothic horror story about a mysterious vampire, fear, darkness, supernatural forces, a dangerous castle, and people fighting against an ancient evil.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: A psychological novel about crime, guilt, morality, poverty, suffering, isolation, and the mental struggle of a man after committing a serious crime.

title: The Brothers Karamazov
author: Fyodor Dostoevsky
description: A philosophical novel about family conflict, morality, religion, guilt, human nature, murder, responsibility, and difficult questions about life.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
description: A novel about wealth, ambition, love, social class, parties, dreams, and the hidden problems behind the glamorous life of wealthy people.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: A romantic novel about relationships, marriage, social class, family expectations, misunderstanding, pride, prejudice, and changing feelings.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
author: Alexandre Dumas
description: An adventure story about betrayal, imprisonment, escape, revenge, wealth, identity, justice, and a man planning revenge against his enemies.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
description: A gothic novel about beauty, youth, desire, morality, corruption, pleasure, identity, and the consequences of living without moral limits.

title: The Martian
author: Andy Weir
description: A science fiction survival story about an astronaut stranded on Mars who uses science, engineering, technology, problem solving, and determination to survive.
